cc:Agent.dc:title: Anthropic - Claude Fable 5.1; Anthropic - Claude Opus 5.5

cc:Work.dc:description: Loading screen built on the official logo, the 4 x 4 Conical M without pieces. Its twelve tiles arrive in a diagonal wave from the top-left corner, each scaling up from its centre with a slight overshoot; a hairline bar under the tagline runs in the accent.
